description: Validates spec-driven development: OpenSpec change artifacts (proposal, REQUIREMENTS with WHEN/THEN, tasks), validation gate, constitution-to-converge on brownfield.

criteria: Brownfield as-is/to-be derived from existing behavior

test_cases.input: I have a new feature to build. Produce the OpenSpec change artifacts (proposal, spec REQUIREMENTS with WHEN/THEN, tasks) before any code.
expected_behaviors: produces proposal.md, spec files with REQUIREMENTS sections using WHEN/THEN clauses, and tasks.md with ordered, dependency-aware steps
does NOT jump to implementation code before the spec artifacts exist

test_cases.input: Validate an existing OpenSpec change proposal that has a spec REQUIREMENTS section with WHEN/THEN statements. Run the validation gate and report.
expected_behaviors: runs the openspec validate gate (or its equivalent)
lists any missing or malformed WHEN/THEN clauses
identifies tasks not traceable to a REQUIREMENTS entry

test_cases.input: Apply the constitution-to-converge pipeline to a brownfield feature: derive spec artifacts from existing code before refactoring.
expected_behaviors: analyzes existing code to extract current behavior into REQUIREMENTS/WHEN-THEN
treats existing behavior as source of truth for the as-is spec
